cases.input: Process P transfers from U1 to U2 while outcome class and acted-upon object remain unchanged.
cases.expect: The businessCapabilityId remains stable; only realization successors change.

cases.input: A department name is proposed as outcomeClassRef.
cases.expect: Rejected because organization names cannot define capability identity.

cases.input: Two capability records carry identical outcomeClass and actedUponObject with different businessCapabilityId values.
cases.expect: Rejected as a duplicate identity; distinct surrogates do not create distinct capabilities.

cases.input: outcomeClass is supplied as free text with no schemeRef and no governed term.
cases.expect: Rejected; outcomeClass requires schemeRef plus code or a governed term.

cases.input: A minted UUID is used as businessCapabilityId with no identityBasis value and no master-key resolution.
cases.expect: Rejected; surrogate identifiers must be marked and resolvable to the register master key.

cases.input: Definition and applicability are refined while the outcome class and acted-upon object are unchanged.
cases.expect: A new immutable versionId is created under the unchanged businessCapabilityId; no successor capability is minted.

cases.input: The outcome class itself is replaced by a materially different outcome class.
cases.expect: A successor capability with a new businessCapabilityId is created; predecessorRef and successorRef are both set and the predecessor status becomes superseded.

cases.input: A change is recorded with the disposition 'a successor or distinct capability is created with lineage'.
cases.expect: Rejected; the change mechanism must resolve to exactly one of version or succession.

cases.input: A parent-child relation with tier label L2 is asserted with no decomposition-edge record carrying validity and supersession.
cases.expect: Rejected; parentage and tier are expressible only as versioned edge records.

cases.input: Two sibling children under one parent at the same tier cover overlapping outcome classes with no declared justification.
cases.expect: Rejected; siblings are mutually exclusive at a tier unless the overlap is declared and justified.

cases.input: Re-decomposition moves capability C from L2 under P1 to L3 under P2.
cases.expect: The prior edge is superseded with validTo set and a new edge opens; businessCapabilityId and versionId are unchanged.

cases.input: A realization binding reference is written onto the BusinessCapability record.
cases.expect: Rejected; CapabilityRealization.capabilityRef is the single authoritative direction.

cases.input: WM-ORG-002 is referenced from BusinessCapability with purpose 'organizational-unit realizer'.
cases.expect: Rejected; BusinessCapability may reference WM-ORG-002 only for register stewardship.

cases.input: A computed coverage percentage is persisted on the BusinessCapability record.
cases.expect: Rejected; coverage is a derived as-of projection and is never stored on the capability.

cases.input: BusinessCapability declares a reference to WM-ACT-001.
cases.expect: Rejected; agent competence and capacity attach to CapabilityRealization, not to the capability.

cases.input: A capability record is created with no effective interval, no assertedAt and no asserterRef.
cases.expect: Rejected; register effective interval, knowledge time and asserter are required.

cases.input: status is set to superseded while successorRef is absent.
cases.expect: Rejected; supersession requires a resolvable successor.

cases.input: status is set to constrained with no entry condition, exit condition or declared effect on coverage projection.
cases.expect: Rejected; lifecycle states without defined semantics are not assignable.

cases.input: A retired capability is hard-deleted while historical realizations and assessments reference it.
cases.expect: Rejected; a tombstone is retained and historical references remain resolvable.

cases.input: The last active realization ends and the capability is automatically set to retired.
cases.expect: Rejected; ending a realization does not change capability status.

cases.input: A fixture input states that a capability moves from unit U1 to unit U2.
cases.expect: Rejected; capabilities do not move between units and the case must be restated as a realization transfer.
